origin.construction: Synthetic live-work snapshots compare an unresolved capacity failure, a healthy multi-issue backlog, existing repair/access ownership, same-issue versus unrelated queued workers, a known provider reset and a foreign notification. Issues have no attempt-state labels. Includes bot-authored issues and unfinished diagnosis after a successful run. Current reads are frozen; execution is not simulated. A creation-exhausted snapshot contrasts unfinished diagnosis and existing PR work with a prepared fix whose only remaining action is a refused PR creation. The control is the last main revision before creation-only admission.
